==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First Interaction)
:'''Vida:''' You're here at last! I was just wondering how much longer I'd have to wait.
:{{DIcon}} Why did you suddenly reach out to me?
:'''Vida:''' Because... 'Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders.'
:'''Abby:''' Hmm, sounds familiar. Isn't that the slogan of the Pioneer Association?
:{{DIcon}} Are you with the Pioneer Association?
:'''Vida:''' I used to be. Back when I was a traveling merchant, I also worked briefly as a contract photographer for the Pioneer Association, capturing landscapes along the trade routes to earn some travel expenses.
:'''Vida:''' Now... as you can see, those strange phenomena have drained the color from many places, making it harder to capture great photos. I've settled down and opened my own shop, so I haven't renewed my contract.
:'''Vida:''' But deep down, I am still unable to move past the faded landscapes.
:{{DIcon}} Do you want me to restore those areas?
:'''Vida:''' Always feels like a breeze to chat with a sharp mind like yours. That is exactly why I got your contact from a former colleague. After all, no one wants the places in their memories to be covered in dull patches, right?
:'''Vida:''' If we can only see those familiar landscapes in photos from now on... it's a depressing thought, isn't it?
:{{DIcon}} Let's talk terms first.
:{{DIcon}} How about a little something to sweeten the deal?
:'''Vida:''' Certainly, I wouldn't expect you to help for free. The Faded Zones often hold abundant mineral deposits and resources. But they can't be accessed due to the influence of the Overflowing Palettes.
:'''Vida:''' Restoring the zones will not only bring back the colors but also the resources. You can trade them with me for some... rare items on the market.
:'''Abby:''' Sounds like this is her true intention...
:'''Vida:''' As a merchant, it's my fundamental skill. So, what do you think? Those goods and offers are exclusively for partners.
:{{DIcon}} Understood, let's seal the deal.
:'''Vida:''' Alright, take a look at what's on the shelves. The resources are just what you need right now.
----
:{{DIcon}} Stillwind Sundries
:;(Opens [[shop]])
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Vida:''' {{Rover}}, Welcome! Would you like to see what's on the shelves?
::{{DIcon}} Where did these rare items come from?
:::'''Vida:''' I used to travel across different regions of Rinascita and built numerous business connections. Many of my goods come through their channels.
:::'''Vida:''' Some items, however, have yet to hit the market for various reasons, such as master chef's secret recipes or practical medicine crafted by local artisans...
:::{{DIcon}} Isn't that... a kind of black market?
:::'''Vida:''' Hah, don't worry. Feel free to use whatever you buy here. No one's going to cause you any trouble. And even if they do... I'm sure you can handle it, right?
::{{DIcon}} Ask about the special shop in Ragunna.
:::'''Vida:''' Ragunna has a shop called "[[Rosemary's Apothecary]]." Perhaps you've visited it already. Its owner, Miss [[Rosemary]], is an odd client of mine. I wonder if you've noticed—
:::'''Vida:''' She sometimes acts like a different person.
::{{DIcon}} I'm good now.
:::'''Vida:''' Some of the items on the shelves are limited in supply, but they will be restocked periodically. Be sure to check back often!
{{Dialogue End}}
